title: NATS request/reply pipelines.providers.test (studio → pipelines)
description: From API 1.15. Core NATS request/reply on subject `pipelines.providers.test` (queue group `pipelines`), bare JSON, for POST /v1/studio/admin/providers/{name}/test. Only pipelines_service ever calls a model provider, so the test is made there: `GET <base_url>/models`, then, with `model`, one chat completion of at most 8 tokens (`Answer with OK.`). The host rule is applied first (a server's base_url must resolve only to loopback or private addresses or what host.docker.internal resolves to in pipelines' container; a remote one must be https, and remote models must be on in pipelines' own setting). Studio waits 30 s (no answer: 503). From API 1.51 also a preset's Fetch (POST /v1/studio/admin/provider-presets/{id}/models): the snapshot is built by studio from the preset file, never from the browser, and comes without `model`. From API 1.53 (plan 28) the snapshot may carry `thinking` (the test's one completion sends that model's level as a batch would), and the reply `reasoning`: what each model's /models entry says of reasoning (OpenRouter's `reasoning` object: only `supported_efforts` and `mandatory` are read; a model without one is absent); studio turns it into ProviderTest.thinking for a preset whose thinking is "models".

models.description: what GET /models listed (the first 1000; 64 before API 1.51)

reasoning.description: from API 1.53: per listed model, its supported reasoning efforts and whether reasoning cannot be turned off

error.description: never the key, never a response body longer than 300 characters

code.description: network: connect, TLS, timeout, 5xx or 429; answer: a 4xx (401: the key) or an answer that is not OpenAI-shaped; refused: the host rule refused the address; off: remote models are off on this deployment; internal
